page.content:
Cobra intelligence officer in glasses and a red sigil.

How The Baroness connects

  • Faction: Cobra — The Baroness is Cobra's intelligence officer.
  • Character: Destro — The Baroness and Destro are Cobra's most durable officer pairing.

What is The Baroness?

The Baroness is Anastasia DeCobray, Cobra's director of intelligence, whose glasses, riding crop, and on-and-off alliance with Destro make her the face of Cobra's officer class.

Key threads lead to Cobra and Destro.
